claim: On September 30, 2025 Amazon ECS added support for Amazon ECS Managed Instances for running containerized workloads.
question: When did ECS Managed Instances become available?
note: Changes the ECS-on-EC2 versus Fargate trade-off: before, the choices were self-managed EC2 instances or Fargate. The What's New post of 2025-09-30 (whats-new-v2#launch-3ravgbqkxjyafxrfr5enhy) says AWS patches and replaces the instances on a 14-day cycle.
